facts.fact: Cinnamon 深夜改简历，抱怨自己作为 The Marbled Bison 的副主厨被开除。
facts.anchor: “How can The Marbled Bison fire me? I was their sous chef! It’s not my fault,”

facts.fact: 好友 Olive 在人气乐队里赚钱，而 Cinnamon 只能真的去揉面团。
facts.anchor: Not everyone could be in a popular band and rolling in the dough.

facts.fact: 床头柜上放着那只茄子条纹、已经破损的青蛙玩偶，六个月前她刚缝补过它。
facts.anchor: My attention flicks to the eggplant striped and tattered frog on the nightstand next to my bed.

facts.fact: 青蛙帮她逃离了可怕的原生家庭，此后辗转寄养家庭，直到十二岁被远房姑婆收养。
facts.anchor: I had been tossed from foster home to foster home until, at the age of twelve, a distant great aunt came out of the woodwork to take me in.

facts.fact: Olive 提议做私人厨师后，Cinnamon 灵光一闪决定当「受雇之刀」，要建网站接单。
facts.anchor: “A knife for hire! That’s what I’ll do! I just need to set up a website.

facts.fact: 她与姑婆 Sherry 谈条件：Sherry 出几百美元建站，一个月还不上就连本带利替她卖新药。
facts.anchor: “What about this, you pay for me to get my website up and running—it should only be a couple hundred dollars—and if I can’t pay you back with interest in the month, I will sell at least one new product for you.”

facts.fact: Sherry 安慰她被开除不是她的错，宇宙也许正把她引向一条她一直想逃开的路。
facts.anchor: “It’s not your fault, sweetheart. Sometimes the universe works in a mysterious way

facts.fact: 相处多年以来 Cinnamon 一直给 Sherry 惹麻烦，厄运似乎跟着她走。
facts.anchor: I was always causing problems for her, because bad luck seemed to follow me wherever I went.
